The woman in the center wears a bright red floral qipao, while her companions wear pale pink and black versions. They begin by performing a synchronized Chinese greeting gesture, clasping a fist in a palm while smiling brightly at the camera. (2) The trio transitions into a coordinated rhythmic dance involving side-to-side torso movements and arm swings. Their facial expressions are consistently cheerful, with wide eyes and open-mouthed smiles, and the studio lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of their silk dresses. (3) The women move closer to the lens, leaning in with playful hand gestures like pointing and double thumbs up. The shot remains static and continuous, capturing the full range of their festive performance without any camera movement or visual cuts.
